resource.title: CMU 15-418/618 Parallel Computer Architecture and Programming（Fall 2026 课程主页）
resource.covers: 主页与 schedule 页公开逐讲 topic、slides 链接、作业与考试安排。已核实的讲次：Why Parallelism、Out-of-order 与多核处理器、Parallel Programming Models、Parallel Programming Basics、GPU Architecture and CUDA Programming、Performance Optimization I/II、Interconnection Networks、Snooping/Directory-Based Cache Coherence、Performance Analysis/Profiling、Implementing Synchronization、Fine-Grained Synchronization 与 Lock-Free Programming、Transactional Memory、Heterogeneous Parallelism、Memory Consistency、Parallel Deep Learning；配合 4 次作业与期末项目，要求学生自己并行化并调优代码，覆盖线程与任务、同步、性能剖析、数据划分与负载均衡。

courses.prereq_text: 15-213 (Introduction to Computer Systems) is a strict prerequisite. ... You are expected to be a strong C/C++ programmer ... 18-447 (Introduction to Computer Architecture) is helpful, but not required. Previous experience with operating systems (15-410), distributed systems (15-440), or compilers (15-411) may also prove helpful.

CS111: Operating Systems Principles is a strongly recommended prerequisite for CS149. If you have not taken CS111 and feel like you have the background to take CS149 ..., please contact your friendly instructors.

extra_prereqs.evidence: CMU 15-418 写 '15-213 ... is a strict prerequisite'（内存层次、内存管理、基本网络）
CMU 15-418 要求“strong C/C++ programmer”；15-213 本身即 C 与机器级编程课
CMU 15-418：'18-447 (Introduction to Computer Architecture) is helpful, but not required'
Stanford CS149 把 CS111 Operating Systems Principles 列为 strongly recommended；CMU 15-418 说 15-410（OS）'may also prove helpful'

notes: C.2.2 记 recommended：CS149 把 CS111（操作系统原理，含线程与同步）写成 strongly recommended，15-418 只是说 OS/分布式/编译器等经历 “may prove helpful”，没有课程把“系统编程与并发同步”列为硬性先修（硬性的是 15-213，按约定映射到 C.1.1 + P.2.2，已计入 extra_prereqs）。两门课的 schedule 都核实过：15-418 有 Parallel Programming Models/Basics、Performance Analysis/Profiling、实现同步与 fine-grained sync、CUDA 等讲次；CS149 的日程逐条写明 ISPC 编程抽象、work stealing 调度 Cilk 程序、message passing 与流水线、以及 CUDA 作业。
